# .github/workflows/browser.yml
- Lines: 308 | Kind: PR-gating workflow (verify monolith + formal + Playwright lanes) | Verdict: KEEP, SPLIT/SIMPLIFY (it becomes the main PR pipeline with parallel lanes)
- Covers: produces the `Repository verification` and `Browser MVP result` checks: `npm run verify` (Quint check, Lemma/Dafny, typecheck, the 1,020-file `npm test`, build, bundle audit), the proof-renderer build, changed-model Apalache proofs, 1 or 6 Chromium shards, the flag-off production project and a dispatch-only Firefox/WebKit storage matrix. Duplicates: `lemma-check.yml` (Lemma), `quint-model-check.yml` (Apalache verify), `android.yml:78-82` (verify on dispatch), `test/quint-composition-refinement.test.mjs` (composition refinement run again at :211-214). Callers/importers: triggers push main+develop, PR, cron 07:23, dispatch; calls `changes.yml`; read as text by `test/ci-required-checks.test.mjs:42,58,98`, `test/ci-emulator-evidence.test.mjs`, `test/cloud-sdk-routing.test.mjs`, `test/cloud-resident-full-profile.test.mjs`, `test/cloud-resident-embedding-route.test.mjs`; selected by `scripts/ci/affected.ts:33`.
- Health (research `ci-and-formal.md` §1): 0 green in last 100 runs; verify killed at 113-120 min, formal 1-118 min, shards 22-25 min.

Path filters per lane (via `affected.ts`): static: any non-doc; host: `test/*.test.*`, `scripts/**`, `apps/app/src/**` (tests importing them), `package*.json`; quint: `specs/quint/**`, manifest `sources`; lemma: `specs/lemma/**`, `LemmaScript-files.txt`, `lemmascript.json`, the 23 listed `apps/app/src` files, `scripts/check-lemma.ts`; browser/production: `apps/app/**`, `test/browser/**`, `playwright.config.ts`, `vite.config.ts`; all lanes: `package-lock.json`, `upstream.lock.json`, `vendor/eliza` pointer, `tsconfig*.json`, unknown.

## Proposed end state
- One PR workflow (`ci.yml`, or this file renamed) with jobs `changes`, `static`, `host` (4 shards), `quint`, `lemma`, `browser` (shards), `production`, `result`; each job `if:` on its lane boolean.
- A composite setup action replaces five copies of checkout/node/npm ci; tool installs move to the lanes that need them.
- No push triggers (PR + schedule + dispatch); nightly schedule runs every lane plus cross-browser storage.
- Composition refinement, Lemma and Apalache each run exactly once per commit.
- `lemma-check.yml` and `quint-model-check.yml` are deleted (their work lives in the `lemma` lane and a nightly `quint-verify` lane).
- Workflow text tests deleted; `actionlint` guards syntax.
